The Chinese characters for Derek

As a transliteration, Derek is usually written 德里克 (Dé lǐ kè). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

德
Dé
virtue, morality
里
lǐ
inside, a mile
克
kè
overcome, gram

Origin and meaning

Derek comes from Germanic and means “ruler of the people”.

About the name Derek

A Germanic name meaning 'ruler of the people', shortened from Theodoric.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Derek carries the meaning “ruler of the people” and looks striking in brush strokes.
